description: A formula's finite free-variable set is empty for falsity, a union of argument-term sets for equality and relation application, a union for implication, and unchanged by a scoped quantifier.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.freeVarFinset.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'} [DecidableEq α]
  {n : ℕ} : L.BoundedFormula α n → Finset α
